answer: The strongest lever is simple: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because signal only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, violet is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any knoll approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
